ROUND 1 -- the playable core, with a title screen. Fixed-timestep game loop at 60 fps. Input BOTH ways in one build, chosen at runtime: WASD and arrow keys on desktop, virtual joystick (drag anywhere) on touch. Movement is the only control. The player character. ONE weapon: the Baseball bat (auto-firing melee arc in the facing direction, knockback, short cooldown). ONE enemy: the Skinhead goon, spawning in waves of rising density and chasing the player. Collision, damage, death, a visible HP bar and a kill counter. The TITLE SCREEN as specified (canvas-drawn antifascist imagery, starts on key AND touch), and the autoplay policy behind ?autoplay=1. Expose the state contract.

ROUND 2 -- progression and three more weapons. Add XP drops from kills, a level bar, and a level-up that pauses and offers THREE upgrade choices (genre standard: new weapon or +1 level to an owned one). Add weapons: Brick (auto-targets nearest, thrown projectile), Molotov cocktail (thrown arc, shatters into a burning pool that damages over time), Chain (thrown out and returns, pierces on both legs). Add enemies: Torchbearer (slow melee, marches in formation) and Troll (tiny, fast, spawns in swarms). Weapons must level 1-8 with real per-level scaling. Add the PUNK ROCK SOUNDTRACK as specified: WebAudio, oscillator bass, noise drums, distortion via a WaveShaperNode, 170-200 bpm, playing on the title screen and in the run, mutable with M and a touch button.

ROUND 3 -- the defensive and area weapons. Add: Banner (orbits the player, sweeps and knocks back), Megaphone (constant damaging aura around the player, repels and staggers), Paint bomb (drops splatter zones at random nearby positions, slow + accuracy debuff), Smoke grenade (defensive zone; enemies inside lose targeting). Add enemies: Suit (tanky, buffs nearby enemies, no attack of its own), Propagandist (ranged, projectiles apply a debuff), Kettle (blockade that constrains player movement).

ROUND 4 -- allies, and the enemy that hides among them. Add neutral bystander entities wandering the arena. Add the Nipster enemy: it spawns DISGUISED among the bystanders and is visually indistinguishable until it acts, is fast once revealed, and converts idle bystanders into enemies if left alone. Add the ally-side weapons: Solidarity bloc (summons allied figures that fight on their own; damage scales with how many are alive), Sound system (radius aura giving cooldown reduction to the player and allies in it), Flyer drop (passive, low chance to convert a weak enemy into an ally), Flare (strikes random enemies anywhere on screen).

ROUND 5 -- passives and evolutions. Add six passive items obtainable from level-ups: Steel toecaps (+damage), Running shoes (+move speed), Black bloc mask (+armour, enemies acquire you more slowly), Affinity group (+1 projectile amount), Adrenaline (-cooldown), Spray paint (+area size). Add chests that drop from elites. Add five evolutions, each triggered by a maxed weapon + the held passive + opening a chest: Baseball bat + Steel toecaps = Sweep (wide arc, stuns); Molotov + Spray paint = Firewall (burning line); Banner + Affinity group = Bloc formation (several orbiting banners); Megaphone + Adrenaline = Sound cannon (much larger aura, hard stagger); Solidarity bloc + Black bloc mask = Mass mobilisation (allies stop expiring).

ROUND 6 -- bosses, stages and an ending. Add two podium bosses with real fight patterns: 'Der Redner', a demagogue at a podium who spawns waves while speaking, where destroying the amplification halts the spawns; and 'Die Funktionaerin', who coordinates rather than shouts -- she buffs and repositions the wave instead of spawning it. Add districts as stages with escalating difficulty, a boss at the end of each, and a real ENDING when the final boss dies (a victory screen with run statistics). The enemy faction wears party blue; the suited types are blue-suited.

ROUND 7 -- make it feel good. Particles on hit, death and pickup. Screen shake on heavy hits. Damage numbers. Procedural sound effects via the WebAudio API for hit, kill, level-up and boss, mixed with the soundtrack. Make the soundtrack react to the game state (boss phase, level-up sting, death). A game-over screen; polish the title screen. Tune the difficulty curve across the whole run. Improve the AUTOPLAY policy so an unattended run survives and progresses: kite away from the nearest cluster, prioritise ranged enemies, pick upgrades from a weight table.
